menu_options.email: Sign in with my Netflix email (recommended)

email.title: Connect Netflix
email.description:
Enter the email or phone number on the Netflix account. Netflix will send a sign-in code to it.

{message}

code.title: Enter Netflix's code
code.description:
Netflix just sent a code to that email or phone. Type it here. It expires in 15 minutes.

{message}

password.title: Netflix password
password.description: Netflix is asking for the account password.

profile.title: Whose history?
profile.description: Pick the Netflix profile to show on the dashboard. Add the integration again for more profiles.

cookies.title: Connect Netflix (advanced)
cookies.description: On a computer, sign in at netflix.com and pick the profile. Open the browser's developer tools → Application → Cookies → https://www.netflix.com, and copy the Value of NetflixId and SecureNetflixId. They act like a password and stay in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_read: Signed in, but Netflix's history page answered in a way this doesn't understand yet.
error.wrong_code: That code didn't work. Check it, or start again to get a new one.

abort.already_configured: That Netflix profile is already connected (its sign-in was updated).
abort.signed_out: Netflix signed in but then refused the history request. Try again.
abort.cannot_read: Signed in, but Netflix's history page answered in a way this doesn't understand yet.

get_history.name: Get Netflix history
get_history.description: Recently watched titles from the connected Netflix profiles.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Netflix profile name or id (default: the last one used).
